source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The changed serialize_get_me, deserialize_paginated_with_page and deserialize_delta_with_page functions use five assert_eq! calls without expected-behavior messages. Their checks cover the selected GET URI, parsed response values and continuation URIs. The expect/panic text describes separate operations and does not supply those assertion messages. This patch adds no direct POST/Other-body, content-type or serialization-error assertion; no test execution is claimed.
title: The Graph byte-request landing retains URI assertions without messages
